A Central de avisos: onde a IA e o siste: The Notification Center: where the AI and the system leave what needs a person on the team, such as a conversation handed over to a human or a message that did not get through.
Conhecendo a tela de Alertas: Getting to know the Alerts screen
Entender o que é a Central de avisos, co: Understand what the Notification Center is, how to get there and how to read each notice.
o que a IA precisa de mim: what the AI needs from me
Alertas fica no hub de IA: Alerts is in the AI hub
A tela Alertas não tem atalho próprio no: The Alerts screen has no shortcut of its own in the side menu. In the "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Alerts" card is in the "Monitor the agent" section. That is where the notices are: what the AI, which serves customers for you, and the system itself have found and need someone on the team to resolve.
O cartão e o sino aparecem para atendent: The card and the bell appear for support staff, managers and administrators, unless the "Interface profile" hides the screen: in the "Simplified" profile, it is left out. People with read-only access do not see the card and, if they open the screen by its address, read that the Notification Center is for those who handle support.
No menu a tela se chama \"Alertas\", mas: In the menu the screen is called "Alerts", but once open, its title is "Notification Center". Each notice is a request for attention: the AI handed a conversation over to the team, a message did not reach the customer, the WhatsApp connection dropped. The bell at the top right of the screen brings you here from any page. The red number on the bell counts the open notices.
Sem nenhum aviso em aberto, o sino fica: With no open notices, the bell shows no number.
Os avisos ficam em duas abas. \"Abertos\: Notices are kept in two tabs. "Open" shows what is still waiting for someone, and the number in parentheses counts how many there are. "Resolved" holds those that have already been closed, by someone on the team or on their own. In "Open", the most severe come first; among notices of the same severity, the most recent come first. The list refreshes on its own every 30 seconds.
Cada linha é um aviso. À esquerda, um se: Each row is a notice. On the left, a badge shows the severity. Next to it is the title, which says what happened. The line below shows the notice type and how long ago it arrived. Then, when there is one, comes the text with the details. In this notice, it says the customer asked to talk to a person and has already been told that someone will take over.
O selo tem três níveis. \"crítico\" é o: The badge has three levels. "critical" is the most urgent: something stopped working or is already affecting a customer, such as a message that did not get through or a customer waiting for a person. "warning" calls for a look soon, but nothing broke, such as a customer who did not reply in time. "informational" is just for you to know, with no rush.
O botão que leva ao problema: The button that takes you to the problem
Muitos avisos trazem um botão que abre o: Many notices have a button that opens the right place to resolve it: the conversation, the connection, the agent. "Open conversation" goes straight to Mariana's conversation in the Inbox. When the notice has nowhere to take you, or when your role cannot open that place, a sentence saying what to do appears instead of the button, as in the last notice on this list.
Se a conversa não está entre as que você: If the conversation is not among those you see in the Inbox, the notice shows "This context is not available to you" instead of the button.
Cuidar do que o aviso pede, saber quais: Take care of what the notice asks, know which notices close on their own, mark as resolved and undo it when it was a mistake.
Primeiro, cuide do que o aviso pede: First, take care of what the notice asks
Resolver um aviso começa por fazer o que: Resolving a notice starts with doing what it asks. In this one, the AI handed Mariana's conversation over to the team because she asked to talk to a person. Click "Open conversation".
A conversa, com o motivo da IA: The conversation, with the AI's reason
O botão abre a conversa no Inbox. O cart: The button opens the conversation in the Inbox. The "Why the AI handed over to you" card tells the reason, what the customer wants, what the AI has already tried and whether the customer has already been told. To handle it, click "Take over": the conversation is assigned to you, and the notice in the Notification Center closes on its own and moves to "Resolved". Taking over and replying have their own lesson, in the Inbox module.
Transferir a conversa para um colega ou: Transferring the conversation to a colleague or returning it to automatic also closes this notice. In this lesson, Mariana's conversation stays as it is.
Outros avisos não se fecham sozinhos. \": Other notices do not close on their own. "A reply did not reach the customer" means a message got stuck and was not sent. The "Open an affected conversation" button takes you to the conversation, here Fernanda's: check what did not get through and decide whether it needs to be sent again. Then click "Mark resolved" on the notice's row. Support staff, managers and administrators can mark it.
O aviso sai de \"Abertos\", e o número d: The notice leaves "Open", and the numbers on the tab and on the bell go down. Nothing is deleted: the notice moves to the "Resolved" tab. Click it.
Em \"Resolvidos\" ficam os avisos já fec: Under "Resolved" are the notices already closed, from the last one to come in to the oldest. Fernanda's, which you just marked, is at the top. Further down are two that closed on their own: Lucas's, which closed when someone on the team took over the conversation, and yesterday's, when the WhatsApp connection came back. Marked it by mistake? Click "Reopen" and the notice goes back to "Open".
Em alguns tipos de aviso, se já existe o: For some notice types, if another identical one is already open, the system does not reopen the old one, so as not to repeat the alert.
Quando a lista junta avisos que já foram: When the list piles up notices that have already been dealt with, "Mark all resolved" closes at once all the open notices you can see, including those that did not fit on the screen: the list shows up to 50. It does not ask for confirmation. If you close something by mistake, the notice stays in "Resolved" and can be reopened, one by one.
Alguns avisos são de uma pessoa só, como: Some notices belong to one person only, such as the task deadline notice: only the person responsible for the task sees it. "Mark all resolved" does not close notices that only a colleague sees.
Configurar o lembrete de caso parado: Set up the stalled case reminder
Escolher se a Central volta a avisar sob: Choose whether the Notification Center notifies again about cases waiting for the team, how often and how many times.
Às vezes a IA abre um caso: um pedido qu: Sometimes the AI opens a case: a request only the team can decide, such as a discount. Cases are on the "Cases" screen. If a case is waiting for the team and no one decides, the Notification Center notifies again, with a notice like "A support request has been awaiting a decision for a day". The "Stalled case reminder" card, at the top of the Notification Center, chooses how these reminders work. The rule applies to the whole company.
Só quem administra a empresa vê este car: Only company administrators see this card. By default, the reminder is on, every 1 day, with 3 notices per wait.
A caixa \"Lembrar a equipe dos casos par: The "Remind the team about stalled cases" box turns the reminders on and off. When unchecked, the Notification Center does not notify again about stalled cases, and the two choices just below are locked. Each case's clock starts when it reaches the team and restarts when the case comes back to the team, for example after the customer replies.
\"Lembrar a cada\" é o tempo entre os le: "Remind every" is the time between reminders, from 1 hour to 3 days. Here we chose "4 hours": the first reminder goes out 4 hours after the case reaches the team, the second after 8 hours, and so on. While the previous reminder is open in the Notification Center, no new one is created about the same case.
O sistema confere os casos parados uma v: The system checks stalled cases once an hour. That is why the shortest interval is 1 hour, and a reminder may arrive up to an hour after the expected time.
\"Avisos por espera\" é quantas vezes, n: "Notices per wait" is the maximum number of times the Notification Center reminds about the same case before stopping: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10. The last reminder says it is the last automatic notice about that case. If the case goes to the customer and then comes back to the team, the count restarts.
As escolhas só valem depois de clicar em: The choices only apply after you click "Save reminder". Click it. The confirmation "Stalled case reminder saved." appears for a few seconds in the bottom right corner.
O cartão sempre mostra o que está gravad: The card always shows what is saved. When you open the Notification Center again, "Remind every" is still on "4 hours": the reminder was saved, and the new rule already applies to the cases waiting for the team.
Quer também receber no WhatsApp quando a: Also want to get a WhatsApp message when the AI opens a case? That is on the "WhatsApp alert" card, under "See everything in AI".
Receber no WhatsApp de alguém da equipe: Get a message on a team member's WhatsApp every time the AI gets stuck in a conversation and needs a person.
Conhecendo a tela de Aviso no WhatsApp: Getting to know the WhatsApp alert screen
Achar a tela e entender cada parte: os q: Find the screen and understand each part: the warning boxes at the top, who sends and who receives the alert, the switch that turns it on and the list of the latest alerts.
avisar a equipe quando a ia travar: alert the team when the ai gets stuck
Esta tela não tem atalho próprio no menu: This screen has no shortcut of its own in the side menu. In the "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "WhatsApp alert" card is in the "Monitor the agent" section. The path is: AI agent › See everything in AI › WhatsApp alert.
Só quem administra a conta vê este cartã: Only account administrators see this card. Managers and support staff do not see it, and the screen does not open for them.
Quando a IA que atende os clientes (nest: When the AI that serves customers (in this clinic, Bia) runs into something only a person can resolve, such as a discount or an extra slot in the calendar, it can open a case, if the assistant has that permission. This screen makes that case arrive as a message on a team member's WhatsApp. The message includes the case type and subject, the customer's first name, what they need, why the AI got stuck and a link to open the conversation. Notice the side menu now highlights "Cases".
O aviso sai uma vez só, quando o caso é: The alert goes out only once, when the case is opened. If the customer replies and the case is waiting for the team again, no new alert goes out: follow it in the Notification Center.
Antes do formulário, a tela lista o que: Before the form, the screen lists what can get in the way of the alert. A red box blocks the alert: while it is there, the switch that turns on the alert stays locked. A gray box blocks nothing, but it is worth reading: some only inform, and others explain why no alert will go out. Each box is explained in the "When the alert does not arrive" lesson.
Em \"Conexão que envia os avisos\" fica: "Connection that sends notifications" holds the clinic's WhatsApp number that sends the message. "Number receiving notifications" holds the phone of the person who wants to be alerted, starting with +55 and the area code. "What to call this number (optional)" is just a name so the team recognizes the number. In this clinic, the alert goes out through "Recepção Bem Viver" and goes to Helena's phone.
A chave \"Receber avisos no WhatsApp\" l: The "Receive alerts on WhatsApp" switch turns the alert on and off. When on, it goes out right away, including at night and on weekends. It only unlocks when three things are right: a selected connection that works for alerts, a complete number and the system's internet address. Here it is on, but grayed out: the red box at the top locks it. What you change in the form only takes effect after you click "Save".
Embaixo fica \"Últimos avisos enviados\": At the bottom is "Latest notifications sent": each row is an alert attempt, with the day, the time, whether it went out or not and why. This is where you check whether alerts are arriving. The "When the alert does not arrive" lesson teaches you how to read each row.
Escolher quem envia e quem recebe: Choose who sends and who receives
Escolher o número da clínica que manda o: Choose the clinic number that sends the alert, enter the phone of the person who receives it, give it a name and save.
trocar número que recebe aviso de caso: change number that receives case alerts
escolher número que envia o aviso: choose number that sends the alert
Clique em \"Conexão que envia os avisos\: Click "Connection that sends notifications" to open the list of the clinic's WhatsApp numbers. Only numbers that can send a message at any time appear. Here there is only "Recepção Bem Viver": click it. If the clinic has no suitable number, the list is locked and a box at the top tells you what to do.
Em \"Número que recebe os avisos\", apag: In "Number receiving notifications", delete the old number and enter the phone starting with the country code: +55, the area code and the number. The screen removes spaces, hyphens and parentheses on its own. While digits are missing, "This number is not complete yet." appears and the "Save" button stays disabled.
Com o número completo, a frase em vermel: With the complete number, the red sentence disappears. In "What to call this number (optional)", give it a name that is easy to recognize, such as "Reception on-call". This name only helps the team know whose number it is: it is not included in the message.
Clique em \"Salvar\": aparece por alguns: Click "Save": the confirmation "Alert saved." appears for a few seconds in the lower corner of the screen. The next alerts go to the new number. To check that it arrives, use "Send test alert": it sends a real message to the saved number, saying the alert is configured. The test uses one message from the clinic number's daily limit, and you can send up to three per hour.
O número que recebe passa a ser um númer: The receiving number becomes a team number: messages it sends to the clinic do not become support conversations in the Inbox. If the test does not go out, the screen tells you why.
Se o número digitado já é de um cliente: If the number entered already belongs to one of your customers, the system asks before saving. Here we entered the phone of Juliana Castro, a clinic patient, and clicked "Save". The box explains: if you continue, messages from this number stop reaching the CRM. "Use anyway" saves it. "Choose another number" closes the box without saving anything.
O número de uma conexão da própria clíni: The system flatly refuses the number of one of the clinic's own connections, such as "Recepção Bem Viver": one number would keep replying to the other nonstop.
Quando o aviso não chega: When the alert does not arrive
Ler os quadros do alto e a lista dos últ: Read the boxes at the top and the list of the latest alerts to find out why an alert did not go out and what to do.
nenhum assistente autorizado a abrir cas: no assistant authorized to open cases
\"Este sistema ainda não tem um endereço: "This system does not have an internet address yet" is a red box: it blocks the alert. The alert message carries a link to open the conversation, and without the system's internet address that link would open nothing. The person who installed the system fixes it by setting the address (the domain). In an installation that already has its own address, this box does not appear.
The alert only goes out when the AI opens a case. "No assistant is authorized to open cases" means no live assistant has that permission, so no alert will go out. Click "Go to assistants", open the assistant and turn on "Let the agent request a task from someone and keep talking", in the "Ask for help without leaving the conversation" box. Then publish the assistant again.
A IA não abre casos: The AI does not open cases
\"Este é o mesmo número que fala com seu: "This is the same number that talks to your customers": "Recepção Bem Viver" also serves patients, and the alerts count toward its same daily message limit. It works, but a number just for alerts is safer. "This number is still warming up": a new number sends few messages per day and increases gradually over about a month, so it is not blocked by WhatsApp. The "Today" line shows how many messages have already gone out and the day's limit.
\"As respostas para este número são igno: "Replies to this number are ignored on purpose": the phone that receives the alerts becomes a team number. What it sends to the clinic does not become a conversation, does not become a contact and does not reach the CRM. That is how the feature works. The box's last line counts how many messages have already been ignored and when the last one arrived. The box appears when the last one arrived within the last 7 days.
Ler a lista dos últimos avisos: Read the list of the latest alerts
Cada linha é uma tentativa de aviso, da: Each row is an alert attempt, from newest to oldest (the last 20 appear). First comes the day and time, then the status: "Delivered", "Not sent", "Canceled" or "Trying to send". Next, the phone that received it, with only the last four digits shown, and the "Open the conversation" link, which opens the case on the "Cases" screen.
Quando a linha diz \"Não saiu\" ou \"Can: When the row says "Not sent" or "Canceled", the sentence below explains why. The newest alert did not go out for the same reason as the red box at the top. Another did not go out because the connection was offline. The canceled one spent more than 24 hours unable to go out. In these cases, open the conversation through the link and resolve it there. For most of these failures, the Notification Center also gets a notice, but this list is what keeps the record: it does not disappear when someone resolves an alert.
Responder pelo WhatsApp e tirar o número: Reply through WhatsApp and remove the number
Ligar as respostas pelo WhatsApp e enten: Turn on replies through WhatsApp and understand the difference between turning off the alert and removing the receiving number.
Normalmente, responder ao aviso não cheg: Normally, replying to the alert goes nowhere: the message itself asks you to open the link. With the "Reply to cases through this WhatsApp" switch on, the person who receives the alert can guide the AI from their own WhatsApp. It comes turned off and only unlocks after the alert has been saved once. Turn on the switch and click "Save".
Depois de salvar, cada aviso passa a tra: After saving, each alert includes the case ID and ready-made templates for the two commands. RESPONDER, the ID and your guidance: the AI uses what you wrote to continue the conversation, without you talking directly to the customer. PERGUNTAR, the ID and the question: the AI clarifies it with the customer. Any other message from this number is still ignored. Since this number sent messages in the last 7 days, the box at the top also changes to "Regular messages from this number are ignored" and starts teaching the commands.
Para parar de receber avisos há dois cam: There are two ways to stop receiving alerts. Turning off the "Receive alerts on WhatsApp" switch and saving pauses the alerts and keeps the number, which remains a team number: what it sends still does not become a conversation. Here the switch is locked by the red box at the top, and you cannot change it. "Remove recipient", on the other hand, deletes the configuration and releases the number: what it sends becomes a conversation in the Inbox again.
A tela pergunta \"Remover o destinatário: The screen asks "Remove the alert recipient?" and explains what happens: the configuration is deleted, the number becomes a regular number again and this screen's history stays. Calendar alerts that use the same number as cases and automations with the "Message to the team" action also stop going out. "Keep" closes the question without changing anything.
Clicando em \"Remover destinatário\", ap: When you click "Remove recipient", the confirmation "Recipient removed." appears for a few seconds and the form goes back to empty, like in an account that never set up the alert. What appears in gray in the fields is only an example. The boxes at the top about the number also disappear. The "Latest notifications sent" list, further down, keeps the history. To receive alerts again, choose the connection and the number again and save.
Mande uma mensagem de WhatsApp para uma: Send a WhatsApp message to a list of contacts you choose, at the number's pace, and track who received it and who replied.
Conhecendo a tela de Campanhas: Getting to know the Campaigns screen
Achar a tela, entender o que é uma campa: Find the screen, understand what a campaign is and read the list: the status of each one and how many people it reaches.
mandar mensagem para vários: send a message to many people
Campanhas não aparece direto no menu lat: Campaigns does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "CRM" group, click "View everything in CRM". The "Campaigns" card is in the "Everyday sales work" section. The full path is: CRM › View everything in CRM › Campaigns.
Só gerente ou administrador usa as campa: Only managers or administrators use campaigns. For other roles, the card appears, but the screen only shows the notice "Error loading campaigns". If the card does not appear at all, the interface may be trimmed down, as with the "Simplified" "Interface profile". Administrators change this in Settings › Organization, for the whole company, or in Settings › Team, in the "Interface" column, for each person.
Uma campanha manda a mesma mensagem de W: A campaign sends the same WhatsApp message to a list of contacts you choose, such as "the Pilates patients". On a number connected by QR code, messages go out gradually, at most one per minute: that is what protects the number from being blocked by WhatsApp. Each row is a campaign. Below the name you see how many contacts are on the list and how many were left out; if the list has not been built yet, it shows "list not prepared yet". On the right is a date that changes with the status: when the campaign was created, when it started or when it ended.
Quantos recebem e quantos ficaram de for: How many receive it and how many were left out
O selo à direita diz em que pé a campanh: The badge on the right shows where the campaign stands. "Draft": it was created, but the list of recipients has not been built yet. After you prepare the list, it becomes "Ready to start". "Sending": the messages are going out. "Paused": sending stopped and is waiting for someone to resume it. "Completed": the campaign finished sending. "Canceled": someone gave up on it, and anyone who had not received it yet will no longer receive it.
Quando a lista crescer, use o seletor \": When the list grows, use the "Status" selector to see only one type of campaign. Here we chose "Completed": only the campaigns that have already ended remain. To see all of them again, choose "All".
\"Nova campanha\" abre o formulário para: "New campaign" opens the form to set up a campaign; the lesson "Create a campaign" shows it step by step. "Settings" holds what applies to all of the company's campaigns: how long a reply counts for the campaign and the list of numbers no campaign reaches.
A tela \"Configuração de campanhas\" com: The "Campaign settings" screen starts with "This organization's defaults". The "Count as a reply up to (hours after sending)" field says how long a message from the contact counts as a reply to the campaign. It comes set to 72 hours, that is, three days. Anything that arrives after that still appears in the Inbox as usual, but does not count as a campaign reply. The change applies to replies that arrive from then on, including for campaigns that have already been sent. To save, click "Save defaults".
A tela diz que toda campanha nova nasce: The screen says every new campaign starts with the pace fields from this section, but for now that is not the case: they are saved, and the "New campaign" screen starts with the pace blank. Adjust the pace in each campaign, in the "This campaign's pace" section.
No fim da tela fica a \"Lista de exclusã: At the bottom of the screen is the "Exclusion list": the numbers no campaign reaches, such as a partner laboratory's or that of a patient who prefers to be notified by phone call. Type the number in "Phone with country and area code" (Brazil's 55, then the area code), write the reason if you want and click "Exclude from campaigns". This does not block the person: if they write, customer support replies as usual. The list shows only the last four digits of each number. To return a number to campaigns, click "Remove from list" on its row.
Mais acima, \"Textos salvos\" guarda com: Further up, "Saved texts" stores, under a name, the messages the team often uses. For now, the "New campaign" screen does not let you choose a saved text.
Montar uma campanha do começo, com nome,: Set up a campaign from scratch, with name, number, audience, message and pace, and save it as a draft without sending anything.
mensagem para um grupo de pacientes: message to a group of patients
Clique em \"Nova campanha\", no canto de: Click "New campaign", in the top right corner. Nothing is sent at this stage: the form only creates a draft, which you will still review before any message goes out.
Em \"Nome da campanha\", escreva um nome: In "Campaign name", write a name that helps the team recognize it; the patient does not see this name. In "Send from number", choose the clinic's WhatsApp number that will send the messages: the list shows the numbers registered in Connections. In "Legal basis for sending", state why the clinic may write to these people, as required by the LGPD, the data protection law. "Consent" applies when they asked to receive messages. "Legitimate interest" applies when the clinic has a written assessment that justifies the contact; in that case the screen asks for the reference of that assessment.
Em \"Público\" você escolhe quem entra n: In "Audience" you choose who joins the campaign, with at least one criterion. Here we used "With any of these tags" and typed convenio: contacts that have this tag are included. Write the tag exactly as it is on record and separate several with commas. You can also leave out people who have a tag ("With none of these tags"), pick people who have not talked to the clinic for a few days ("Not in touch with us for (days)") or people who have a deal in a pipeline ("With a deal in the pipeline"). The "Maximum contacts in this campaign" field already comes set to 100.
Quantas pessoas a campanha pega: How many people the campaign reaches
Clique em \"Ver quantas pessoas\" para c: Click "See how many people" to count before saving. The count shows how many can receive it and how many are left out, with the reason for each group. Here, 1 can receive it and 1 is left out because of "Already in another campaign that has not finished": Fernanda is already on the list of a campaign that is still sending, and nobody is in two campaigns at the same time. Other common reasons are a contact without a phone number, people who asked not to receive messages and numbers on the exclusion list.
Recebem e ficam de fora: Who receives and who is left out
Em \"Mensagem\", escreva como se falasse: In "Message", write as if you were talking to just one person. The buttons right below add, at the end of the text, a field that changes for each contact: {{nome}} is the name on record, {{primeiro_nome}} is just the first name and {{saudacao}} becomes "Good morning", "Good afternoon" or "Good evening", depending on the time it is sent. Anyone missing the data the message uses is left off the list, with the reason noted.
Em \"Quem responder\" dá para escolher e: In "Whoever replies" you can choose in which pipeline the deal is created for people who reply to this campaign and which AI agent handles that reply. This only applies to conversations that start from the campaign: anyone who was already talking to the clinic stays with whoever was handling them. If left blank, the usual applies: the deal is created in the number's pipeline and the reply is handled by the agent published on it. In "This campaign's pace", leave it blank to use the number's pace, which is in Connections › Sending protection. Whatever you enter here can only make the campaign slower. When everything is ready, click "Save draft".
Ao salvar, a tela abre a campanha nova c: When you save, the screen opens the new campaign with the "Draft" badge. No message has gone out. While it is a draft, "Edit" changes what you wrote. The next step is "Prepare list", which builds the list of who will receive it: that is the lesson "Prepare the list and start sending".
Preparar a lista e iniciar o envio: Prepare the list and start sending
Transformar um rascunho em lista de verd: Turn a draft into a real list, check who was left out and why, send a test and only then start sending.
Na lista, clique na campanha em \"Rascun: In the list, click the "Draft" campaign you want to send. Here it is "Invitation to the dental assessment", which the clinic set up for contacts without the convenio tag.
No alto ficam o nome, o selo da situação: At the top are the name, the status badge and only the buttons that make sense right now. On a draft they are "Edit", "Prepare list", "Cancel campaign" and "Duplicate". The "On the list", "Sent", "Delivered" and "Replied" numbers are still at zero, because the list of recipients does not exist yet. It is only built when you click "Prepare list".
Ao clicar em \"Preparar lista\", o siste: When you click "Prepare list", the system looks up the audience's contacts and checks, one by one, who can receive it. The campaign becomes "Ready to start", and "On the list" shows how many will receive it. No message has gone out yet. The buttons changed too: now "Send test" and "Start sending" appear, and "Edit" is gone.
Quem ficou de fora, e por quê: Who was left out, and why
Em \"Quem está na lista\" aparece cada c: "Who is on the list" shows each contact in the audience. "Queued" means the person will receive it. The others show the reason they were left out, such as "No phone on record", "Asked not to receive messages", "On the campaign exclusion list" or "Already in another campaign that has not finished". To see only those left out, choose "Off the list" in the selector next to the title.
Depois de preparada, a campanha não volt: Once prepared, the campaign can no longer be edited on screen. If the list or the message is wrong, click "Cancel campaign", confirm and then click "Duplicate": the copy starts as a draft, ready to fix.
Antes de começar, mande um teste para ve: Before starting, send a test to see how the message arrives. Click "Send test" and search for who will receive it, preferably yourself, registered as a contact. The test goes out from the same number and with the same text as the real sending, and it does not count in the campaign's numbers. Note: "Send to this one" sends the message right away, without asking for confirmation. So do not choose a patient.
Busque quem recebe o teste: Search for who gets the test
Quando estiver tudo certo, clique em \"I: When everything is right, click "Start sending". The screen asks for confirmation first: it shows how many people it will send to and warns that sending follows the number's pace and may take hours. Only when you click "Confirm" does the campaign become "Sending" and the messages start going out. "Back" cancels without sending anything.
Acompanhar, pausar e repetir uma campanh: Track, pause and repeat a campaign
Ler os números de uma campanha em andame: Read the numbers of a campaign in progress, see who replied, adjust the pace, pause and send again with "Duplicate".
Abrir a campanha que está enviando: Open the campaign that is sending
Clique na campanha com o selo \"Enviando: Click the campaign with the "Sending" badge. Here it is "October nutrition assessment", which started going out a few hours ago.
Os quatro quadros resumem o envio. \"Na: The four boxes summarize the sending. "On the list": how many made it onto the list to receive it. "Sent": how many have already gone out. "Delivered": how many reached the person's phone. "Replied": how many replied within the time limit set in "Settings" (72 hours, if nobody changed it). In "Progress", the bar shows how much of the list is done; below it you see how many messages have not been sent yet, how many failed and how many people asked to stop. While the campaign is sending, the numbers update on their own every 10 seconds.
Em \"Quem está na lista\", cada pessoa a: In "Who is on the list", each person appears with their status: "Queued" (will still receive it), "Sent", "Delivered", "Read", "Replied", "Failed" or the reason they were left out. The selector next to the title filters the list. Here we chose "Replied" and only Pedro remained. His reply arrives in the Inbox, like any message.
Em \"Ritmo desta campanha\" dá para deix: In "This campaign's pace" you can slow down the sending even while it is in progress. This campaign waits at least 120 seconds between one message and the next, sends at most 40 per day and only sends from 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. A blank field uses the number's pace. After changing it, click "Save pace".
Para parar o envio por um tempo, clique: To stop sending for a while, click "Pause", at the top; here we have already clicked it. The campaign becomes "Paused" and nobody else receives it until someone clicks "Resume". A message that was already going out at the moment of the pause may still arrive. To give up for good, use "Cancel campaign": the screen asks for confirmation, and afterwards anyone who has not received it yet will no longer receive it and the campaign does not run again.
Uma campanha \"Concluída\" não envia de: A "Completed" campaign does not send again. To repeat the idea, open the campaign and click "Duplicate". The copy starts as a "Draft", with the same number, the same message, the same audience and the same pace. The old campaign's list and results do not go to the copy, nor do the pipeline and agent chosen in "Whoever replies".
Depois de clicar em \"Duplicar\", a tela: After you click "Duplicate", the screen stays on the old campaign, with no notice. The copy appears in the Campaigns list, with "(copy)" at the end of the name and the "Draft" badge. Open the copy, use "Edit" to change the name and review the message, and follow the lesson "Prepare the list and start sending".
O histórico das ligações de telefone que: The history of the phone calls the AI voice agent made and received, with the outcome of each one and, in writing, what was said.
Conhecendo a tela de Chamadas: Getting to know the Calls screen
Achar a tela, entender de onde vêm as li: Find the screen, understand where the calls come from and read each column and each status in the list.
Chamadas não aparece direto no menu late: Calls does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "CRM" group, click "View everything in CRM". The "Calls" card is in the "Everyday sales work" section. The full path is: CRM › View everything in CRM › Calls.
Só gerente ou administrador vê este cart: Only managers or administrators see this card. It also disappears for people using the "Simplified" interface profile. Support staff who open the screen's address see "No calls yet.", even if there are calls: they do not have permission to see them, and the screen does not say so.
Chamadas é o histórico das ligações de t: Calls is the company's phone call history: the calls the AI voice agent made to customers and the ones customers made to the company's number, which the AI answers. Each row is a call, from newest to oldest, and the screen shows the 50 most recent. Everything depends on telephony, an optional feature that whoever manages the server needs to turn on. Without telephony, the list stays empty, with the notice "No calls yet.".
As ligações recebidas chegam pelo número: Incoming calls arrive through the number registered in Connections, on the "Phone" tab. WhatsApp voice calls are not included in this list.
\"Data\" é o dia e a hora em que a ligaç: "Date" is the day and time the call started. "Direction" says who called: "Inbound" is the customer calling the company, and "Outbound" is the AI calling the customer. "Who it is" shows the customer's phone number. Today only the number appears, even when it belongs to a registered contact. "Status" tells how the call ended, and the next step explains each one. "Duration" is the talk time, in minutes and seconds, counted from when the call was answered until the end.
\"Concluída\": a ligação foi atendida, a: "Completed": the call was answered, the AI talked and the call has already ended. "Not answered": the AI called and nobody answered. A busy line also shows up this way. "Failed": the system could not even start the call, for example because the server's phone service was down. "Canceled": the call was rejected. This is what happens when a blocked contact calls: the system hangs up right away, and the AI does not answer.
Enquanto a ligação acontece, ela aparece: While the call is happening, it appears as "Calling" (ringing) and then "In progress" (talking). The list does not update by itself: reload the page to see the status change.
\"Atendido por\" mostra \"IA\" quando a: "Answered by" shows "AI" when the call was handled by the AI voice agent. Every call requested with the "New call" button starts out with the AI, even if nobody answers. On an incoming call the AI never joined, the screen shows "Human", even if no person answered. That is the case with the rejected call in this list. A call without a conversation shows a dash under "Duration".
Ler o que foi falado numa ligação: Read what was said on a call
Abrir uma ligação e entender a transcriç: Open a call and understand the transcript: what the AI said, what the customer said and when there is no text.
Toda linha da lista abre os detalhes da: Every row in the list opens the call's details. Click the most recent call, an inbound call that ended as "Completed".
Abre uma janela com a transcrição: a con: A window opens with the transcript: the conversation in writing, sentence by sentence. At the top are the customer's number, the day and time, the direction and the status. The gray bubbles on the left are what the AI said. The screen always labels them with the name "Iara", whatever your agent's name is. The colored bubbles on the right are what the customer said, with their number on top.
A transcrição só é gravada quando a liga: The transcript is only saved when the call ends: while it is in progress, the window shows "No transcript for this call.". The screen shows only the text, not the audio.
Feche a janela e abra a ligação de saída: Close the window and open the outbound call right below. When the system did not pick up any words in a turn, the bubble shows "(no audio detected)". Here the customer answered without saying anything, and the AI called out: "Hello?".
Para fechar a janela, clique no X do can: To close the window, click the X in the corner or press the Esc key.
Agora abra a ligação \"Não atendida\". L: Now open the "Not answered" call. A call that nobody answered, that failed or that was rejected has no conversation. That is why the window shows only the top and the notice "No transcript for this call.".
Pedir para a IA ligar para alguém: Ask the AI to call someone
Usar o botão \"Nova ligação\" e saber o: Use the "New call" button and know what needs to be ready for the AI to be able to call.
\"Nova ligação\" pede ao agente de IA de: "New call" asks the AI voice agent to call a number and carry the conversation on its own. You do not speak on the call: for now, only the AI speaks. Click "New call".
Só gerente ou administrador consegue ped: Only managers or administrators can request the call.
Digite no campo \"Número\" o telefone pa: In the "Number" field, enter the phone number the AI will call. When the field is empty, the gray text inside it shows an example of how to write it. The "Call with AI" button only becomes available when the number has at least 8 characters.
Aqui não vamos clicar em \"Ligar com IA\: Here we will not click "Call with AI", because the call would be real. When you click it, the system checks the company's phone line, registered in Settings › SIP Trunk, a screen only the administrator opens. Without that line registered and active, and without a default line on the server, an error notice appears saying no SIP trunk is configured, and no call is made. With the line ready, the window closes and the call enters the list as "Calling". When the person answers, it changes to "In progress". At the end, it becomes "Completed" or "Not answered".
Para a IA conversar, a empresa precisa d: For the AI to talk, the company needs an active AI voice agent: without one, the person answers and the call drops. If the server cannot make the call, an error message appears and the call is recorded as "Failed". The list does not update by itself: reload the page to see the new status. Today, if the company has any contact marked as personal, calls requested from here do not appear in the list.
O balcão da clínica: abrir a conta de ca: The clinic's front desk: open the tab for each appointment, add the services, take the payment and, when needed, cancel or refund.
Conhecendo a tela de Comandas: Getting to know the Service tabs screen
Achar a tela pelo hub do CRM e entender: Find the screen through the CRM hub and understand the list of service tabs, the three statuses of a tab and what appears when you open one.
Comanda é a conta de um atendimento: o q: A service tab is the bill for one appointment: what was done and how much the customer pays. Service tabs does not appear directly in the left menu. In the "CRM" group, click "View everything in CRM". The "Service tabs" card is in the "Everyday sales work" section. The full path is: CRM › View everything in CRM › Service tabs. To continue, click the card.
O cartão só aparece depois que quem admi: The card only appears after the server administrator installs the "Service tabs" module in Admin, under "Modules". The installation applies to every company on the server. Without it, neither the card nor the screen exists.
À esquerda fica a lista de comandas, da: On the left is the list of service tabs, from newest to oldest. Each row shows the tab number, the status and the amount. Numbers are sequential: each new tab gets the next one. At the top, "New service tab" opens a blank tab. On the right is the tab you choose. While none is chosen, it says "Choose a service tab on the left.".
A lista mostra as 50 comandas mais recen: The list shows the 50 most recent service tabs. People with the "Read-only" role can see the tabs, but not "New service tab", the fields for adding items and closing the bill, or the appointments without a tab.
Toda comanda está numa de três situações: Every service tab has one of three statuses. "Open": the appointment is still happening and you can add services; the amount is the sum of what has been added so far. "Finalized": the customer paid; the amount is what was charged, and the tab takes no more services. "Canceled": it was undone without charging and shows R$ 0,00. No tab is ever deleted: a canceled one stays on the list, so no one loses the day's history.
Abrir uma comanda da lista: Open a tab from the list
Clique numa linha para ver a comanda à d: Click a row to see the service tab on the right. The number and status are at the top. Below comes each item added, with its amount, and the "Total". This tab, #4, also shows "8 point(s)": that is its customer's loyalty points balance. This balance only appears when the tab has a customer. Since it is open, further down are the fields for adding services and closing the bill, which you will learn in the next lessons.
Embaixo da lista fica \"Atendimentos sem: Below the list is "Appointments without a service tab". These are Calendar appointments from the last 30 days that have already started, are confirmed or completed, and do not have a tab yet. Each row shows the service, the date and the service's default price. When the service has no registered price, "no price on the service" appears and the row cannot be checked. The last lesson shows how to charge for several appointments at once.
Esta parte só aparece quando existe algu: This section only appears when there is an appointment in this situation, and only for people who can add to service tabs: support staff, managers and administrators.
Abrir uma comanda e lançar serviços: Open a service tab and add services
Abrir uma comanda nova e lançar nela um: Open a new service tab and add a registered service and a one-off item to it.
Quando o cliente chega, clique em \"Nova: When the customer arrives, click "New service tab". The tab starts open, with the next number, and already appears selected on the right. It starts without a customer, so it shows no loyalty points.
Atendentes, gerentes e administradores a: Support staff, managers and administrators open service tabs and add items to them; people with the "Read-only" role do not see this button. This screen has no place to choose the tab's customer. A tab already starts with a customer in two cases: when it comes from "Bill" in the appointments without a service tab and the appointment has a contact; or when a deal is won in a pipeline that has the option "Open a service tab when a deal is won in this pipeline" turned on, in CRM › View everything in CRM › Pipeline stages. In that case the tab starts with the deal's amount and contact.
A comanda #6 apareceu no alto da lista c: Tab #6 appeared at the top of the list as "Open" and, on the right, with the "Total" at R$ 0,00. Just below are the fields for adding what was done: "Service", "Description" and "Amount", and the "Add" button.
In "Service", choose what was done. The list shows the clinic's appointment types, the same ones as in Settings › Appointment types. When you choose one, "Description" is filled with the service name. "Amount" is filled with the service's default price, when it has one and the field is still empty. You can change both before adding. Then click "Add".
O serviço entrou na comanda: The service went onto the tab
O serviço virou uma linha da comanda, co: The service became a row on the tab, with its amount, and the "Total" was updated. The fields are blank again for the next item. Added something by mistake? The "×" at the end of the row removes the item right away, while the tab is open.
Um item que não está na lista: An item that is not on the list
Para cobrar algo que não é um serviço da: To charge for something that is not a service on the list, such as a product sold at the front desk, leave "Service" on "One-off". Enter the "Description" and the "Amount", with a comma before the cents. The "Add" button is only available when the description is filled in and the amount is a valid number. Then click "Add".
Agora a comanda tem dois itens e o \"Tot: Now the tab has two items and the "Total" is their sum: R$ 175,00. The list on the left shows the same amount next to #6. The tab stays open until someone closes the bill, which is the subject of the next lesson.
Fechar a conta: finalizar, estornar ou c: Close the bill: finalize, refund or cancel
Receber o pagamento de uma comanda, desf: Take payment for a service tab, undo a charge with a refund and cancel a tab opened by mistake.
Os campos de fechar a conta: The fields for closing the bill
Abra a comanda que vai ser paga; aqui, a: Open the service tab that is going to be paid; here, #4. Below the fields for adding items is the closing section. In "Payment method", choose how the customer paid; the list shows the methods registered in Settings › Finance. Since this tab has a customer, "Loyalty points" also appears. "Finalize" closes the bill. "Cancel service tab" undoes the tab without charging.
Forma de pagamento sem conta: A payment method with no account
Cada forma de pagamento diz em que conta: Each payment method says which account the money goes to, such as the bank account or the reception cash drawer. If the chosen method has no account yet, the notice "This payment method does not have a destination account yet. Set it in Settings › Finance." appears just below. The "Finalize" button stays available, but with this method the system refuses to finalize and the tab stays open. Set the account in Settings › Finance or choose another method.
Escolha uma forma com conta, como \"Pix\: Choose a method with an account, such as "Pix". In "Loyalty points", enter how many points the customer earns on this visit, as a whole number; empty means no points. The "Finalize" button is only available after the payment method is chosen. When you click it, the system saves the total and the payment method, records the inflow in that method's account and adds the points to the customer's balance.
A comanda passou para \"Finalizada\", na: The tab changed to "Finalized", on the list and at the top, and the customer's balance went up to "10 point(s)". The fields for adding items and closing disappeared: a finalized tab takes no more items. A charge that has been made can only be undone with a refund, which appears below for managers and administrators.
Atendentes lançam e finalizam comandas,: Support staff add items to and finalize service tabs, but do not see the refund.
Estornar é desfazer uma comanda já paga,: Refunding means undoing a service tab that was already paid, for example when the customer paid twice. Enter the reason in "Refund reason": it is required and needs at least 3 characters. Then click "Refund". There is no confirmation question. The system does not delete the money inflow: it records an outflow of the same amount in the same account and removes the points the tab gave. If the tab generated a commission, the commission is marked as refunded.
No alto, a comanda agora diz \"Finalizad: At the top, the tab now says "Finalized · refunded", and the customer's balance went back to "8 point(s)". The refund field disappeared, because a tab can only be refunded once. Note: on the list on the left it still appears only as "Finalized".
Comanda aberta por engano não se apaga:: A tab opened by mistake is not deleted: you cancel it. Open the tab, here #5, and click "Cancel service tab". It is canceled right away, with no confirmation question and without charging anything. The tab stays on the list as "Canceled", with R$ 0,00. The items are still visible, but it no longer accepts items or payment.
Cobrar os atendimentos sem comanda: Charge for appointments without a service tab
Conferir os atendimentos da Agenda que f: Review the Calendar appointments left without a service tab and charge for several at once.
Os atendimentos da Agenda que já acontec: Calendar appointments that have already happened and have not become a service tab yet are in "Appointments without a service tab". Nothing comes checked: you review each row and check only what you are going to charge for. The row shows the service, the date and the service's default price. "Nutrition follow-up" has no registered price, so it cannot be checked. To charge for it here, register the service's price in Settings › Appointment types.
Uma comanda aberta em \"Nova comanda\" n: A tab opened with "New service tab" is not linked to the appointment. If you charge for the appointment through it, the row stays on this list, and someone may charge for it again later.
Marcar e escolher a forma de pagamento: Check and choose the payment method
Marque os atendimentos que vai cobrar e: Check the appointments you are going to charge for and choose the payment method, which applies to all the checked ones. The button shows the sum of what was checked; here, "Bill (R$ 350,00)". Review it and click it.
Escolha uma forma de pagamento com conta: Choose a payment method with an account. With a method that has no account, the same notice as when closing the bill appears. If you bill anyway, each checked appointment becomes an open tab, which has to be closed one by one.
Cada atendimento marcado virou uma coman: Each checked appointment became its own service tab, already "Finalized", with the service's default price: here, #6 and #7. They left the list of appointments without a tab and are now completed in the Calendar. The one with no price is still there, waiting. The screen does not show a summary of what was charged: check it on the list of service tabs.
Não existe desfazer em lote. Para devolv: There is no bulk undo. To give back one of these charges, refund its tab, one by one.
Só sobrou o sem preço: Only the one with no price is left
O material da sua empresa que o agente d: Your company's material that the AI agent reads before replying: frequently asked questions, preparation instructions, policies. Here you teach, review and take material offline.
Conhecendo a tela de Conhecimento: Getting to know the Knowledge screen
Entender o que é o acervo do agente, o q: Understand what the agent's library is, what the key notice means and what each material card shows.
Conhecimento não aparece direto no menu: Knowledge does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Knowledge" card is in the "Teach the agent" section. The full path is: AI agent › See everything in AI › Knowledge.
Só gerente ou administrador vê este cart: Only managers or administrators see this card. For people with the "Support staff" or "Read-only" role, it does not appear, and the screen's address leads to the "403 — Permission denied" page.
O agente de IA é o atendente virtual que: The AI agent is the virtual assistant that replies to patients on WhatsApp. This screen, "What the agent knows", stores the clinic's material that it reads before replying: frequently asked questions, exam preparation, prices. With the material, it looks for the right answer instead of improvising. The screen belongs to the whole company: each assistant chooses, on its own screen, which of these materials it can read.
Para o agente conseguir procurar no mate: For the agent to be able to search the material, the system prepares the text with the help of an artificial intelligence service: OpenAI, OpenRouter or Google. This requires a key from that service, called an "embedding key". It can be added by the company or come with the installation. When there is a working key, the sentence "Ready to prepare material." appears instead of this notice. At this clinic the material was prepared by OpenAI, and there is no usable OpenAI key anymore. That is why the notice has the triangle: until this is fixed, the agent cannot look up the material.
Uma chave deixa de ser utilizável quando: A key stops being usable when it is deleted, disabled or rejected when checked with the service. How to add the key is explained in the lesson "Add the key that prepares the material".
O quadro \"Estado da base de conheciment: The "Knowledge base status" panel counts the materials in the library, excluding archived ones. "ready" are the ones the agent already finds. "with errors" are the ones that failed to prepare. When one is being prepared at that moment, "preparing" also appears. Material waiting for the key counts in the total, but not in "ready" or "with errors". When something fails, the line below, with the triangle, says where to see the reason.
Com chave valendo e tudo preparado, o qu: With a working key and everything prepared, the panel shows "all ready", in green. With no material at all, the panel does not even appear.
À esquerda, a tela diz quantos materiais: On the left, the screen says how many materials are in the library, not counting archived ones. "Add material" opens the form to teach the agent something new. "Prepare everything again" tells the system to prepare all materials again; whatever was already ready and has not changed is skipped. This button stays disabled while there is no working key.
A lista se atualiza sozinha: quando o si: The list updates by itself: when the system finishes preparing a material, the card changes without you reloading the page.
Cada cartão é um material. No alto vêm o: Each card is a material. The name is at the top and, below it, the type, such as "Questions and answers". "Prepared" says how long ago the system last prepared the material, or "never"; after 30 days, the date appears. "Excerpts the agent finds" is how many pieces the text was split into for the search. "Consulted by" lists the assistants that read this material.
\"nenhum assistente ainda\", em laranja,: "no assistant yet", in orange, means that no assistant has selected this material. To connect it, open "Agents", go into the assistant, select the material in "What it checks before replying" and publish. Only the published version counts.
O selo colorido no canto do cartão diz e: The colored badge in the corner of the card tells you where the material stands. "The agent already knows", in green: it is prepared and the agent finds it. "Not accepted", in red: preparation failed, and the reason is in "Why it was not accepted". "Waiting for the key", in orange: the material was saved, but it will only be prepared when there is a working key.
Dois selos não aparecem aqui. \"Ainda nã: Two badges do not appear here. "Not prepared yet", in gray, is the one for material that has not gone through preparation yet, such as a newly added one. "Preparing…", in blue, appears while the system is preparing.
Cadastrar a chave que prepara o material: Add the key that prepares the material
Saber de onde vem a chave de embedding e: Find out where the embedding key comes from and add it without leaving the Knowledge screen.
Dentro do aviso, a linha \"Quem prepara: Inside the notice, the "Who prepares the base" line says which service prepared this clinic's material: here, OpenAI. To fix it without leaving the screen, click "Add the key here". The "AI › Credentials" link leads to the screen with all of the company's AI keys.
O material já preparado só é encontrado: Material that has already been prepared can only be found with the same service that prepared it. That is why, in a base prepared by OpenAI, a Google key is not used on its own (and vice versa).
Em \"Provedor da chave de embedding\", e: In "Embedding key provider", choose which service the key is from: OpenAI, OpenRouter or Google. Since this base is prepared by OpenAI, the key must be from OpenAI or OpenRouter. The text of the materials is sent to the chosen service to prepare the search. In "What do you want to call this key", give it a name so you can recognize it later; if you leave it blank, it gets the suggested name, such as "OpenAI key".
Se você cadastrar uma chave do Google, e: If you add a Google key, it is not used on its own: the "Switch to Google" button appears, and switching prepares the whole base again.
No campo \"Chave da OpenAI\", cole a cha: In the "OpenAI key" field, paste the key you created on the service's website; the address appears just below the field, such as platform.openai.com/api-keys. The key is stored encrypted and never shows on the screen again. Click "Save key". The system checks the key with the service, which takes a few seconds. When it is accepted, the notice is replaced by "Ready to prepare material.", with the key's name. If the service rejects the key, the notice stays.
Só administrador consegue salvar a chave: Only an administrator can save the key: a manager sees the form, but the system refuses to save it. With a working key, click "Prepare everything again" to prepare right away the material that was left behind. "Cancel" closes the form without saving anything.
Cadastrar um material novo: escolher o t: Add a new material: choose the type, write questions and answers in the right format and save it to the library.
Para ensinar algo novo ao agente, clique: To teach the agent something new, click "Add material", on the right, above the cards.
Que tipo de material é: What type of material it is
Primeiro escolha o tipo. \"Perguntas e r: First choose the type. "Questions and answers" comes already selected: these are the questions that keep coming up, with the answer ready. It is the format the agent quotes best, because each answer arrives whole. "Document" is continuous text, such as a policy or a manual. "Past conversations" and "Product catalog" are disabled: the system itself fills them, with conversations marked as reusable and with the products synced from the store. You cannot type anything in them.
Com \"Documento\", você envia um arquivo: With "Document", you upload a file or paste the text. "File (optional)" takes PDF, Markdown, CSV or text, up to 20 MB. If you do not have the file, paste the text in the "…or paste the text here" field. The PDF must have text that can be selected: a PDF made only of scanned images has no letters at all for the system to read.
Planilha do Excel não entra direto: salv: An Excel spreadsheet does not go in directly: save it as CSV before uploading.
Agora vamos cadastrar perguntas e respos: Now let's add questions and answers. Click "Questions and answers" again. In "Material name", give it a name you will recognize later. In "Content", write each item on two lines: one starting with "## Pergunta:" and the other with "## Resposta:". Leave a blank line between one item and the next.
As marcas \"## Pergunta:\" e \"## Respos: The "## Pergunta:" and "## Resposta:" markers are written in Portuguese, even when the screen is in another language. Without them, the system finds no pairs and does not save the material.
Antes do botão, o formulário avisa, em l: Before the button, the form warns, in orange letters, when there is no working key: the material is saved and waits, and the agent only gets to know it after the key is added. Click "Add to the library". "Cancel" closes the form without saving anything.
O material entrou no acervo: The material is in the library
O material novo aparece primeiro na grad: The new material appears first in the grid, with the "Not prepared yet" badge. With a working key, the system starts preparing it within moments: the badge changes to "Preparing…" and then to "The agent already knows". Without a key, as at this clinic, the badge changes to "Waiting for the key".
Material novo ainda não é lido por nenhu: New material is not read by any assistant yet. Select it on the assistant's screen, in "What it checks before replying", and publish.
Ler o que está guardado num material, ve: Read what is stored in a material, see what the agent learned from it, correct the content, understand why a material was not accepted and take a material offline.
Para ver o que está guardado num materia: To see what is stored in a material, click "Read the material", at the bottom of the card. Clicking the material's name does the same.
A página mostra o material como ele foi: The page shows the material as it was added. In a questions-and-answers material, each item appears with the "Question" on top and the "Answer" below. In a document, the whole text appears. To return to the list, click "Back to the library".
\"Ver o que ele aprendeu\", no pé do car: "See what it learned", at the bottom of the card, shows the excerpts the agent searches before replying: the pieces the system split the material into. When the agent gets a subject wrong, this is where you see why. Next to each excerpt is its size in tokens, the measure of text that AI services use. The button only appears when the material already has excerpts.
\"Editar conteúdo\" abre o texto atual d: "Edit content" opens the material's current text, in the same "## Pergunta:" and "## Resposta:" format. Change whatever you need and click "Save content". What you save replaces the previous content, and the system prepares the material again.
\"Editar conteúdo\" só existe nos materi: "Edit content" only exists for questions-and-answers materials. A document cannot be edited here: to replace it, archive the old one and add the new version.
Num material com o selo \"Não entrou\",: On a material with the "Not accepted" badge, click "Why it was not accepted" to see the reason. It shows the service's response, sometimes in English. Here, "Incorrect API key provided" means that OpenAI rejected the key. After fixing the cause, for example by adding a key that works, click "Prepare again" for the system to try once more.
Quando um material não entra, a Central: When a material is not accepted, the Notification Center also receives a notice.
Para tirar um material do ar, clique em: To take a material offline, click "Archive". There is no confirmation question: the click archives it right away, and no assistant consults that material anymore. Before that, look at "Consulted by": the assistants listed there stop knowing about that subject.
O material sai da grade e entra na lista: The material leaves the grid and goes into the list of archived materials, at the bottom of the screen. Click it to see the names. Archived material is not deleted, but there is no button to bring it back either: to use the content again, add it again. You can use the same name as the archived one.
Onde você guarda a chave da sua conta de: Where you store the key for your artificial intelligence account, the one the agents use to think, and check whether it is working.
Entender o que é uma chave de IA, onde e: Understand what an AI key is, where it is stored and what each card on the screen shows.
onde coloco a chave: where do I put the key
Credenciais fica no hub de IA: Credentials is in the AI hub
A tela Credenciais não tem atalho própri: The Credentials screen has no shortcut of its own in the side menu. In the "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Credentials" card is in the "Set up the agent" section. That is where you store the key for your artificial intelligence (AI) account, the one the agents use to think and reply.
Só o gerente e o administrador veem este: Only managers and administrators see this card and can open this screen.
Os agentes usam uma inteligência artific: The agents use an artificial intelligence hired from a company, called a provider, such as Anthropic (Claude) or OpenAI (GPT). The account with that provider is yours: you sign up directly with it, and the charges go to that account. For the system to use your account, the provider gives you a key: a long code that works like a password. You paste the key here. It is stored encrypted and never appears in full on the screen again, not even for you.
Se quem instalou o sistema colocou uma c: If whoever installed the system added an AI key during installation, that key does not appear in this list, but the agents can use it: in the agent editor it appears as "This installation's key".
As chaves aparecem agrupadas por provedo: The keys are grouped by provider, with the provider's name above each group. Each card is a key. At the top of the card is the name you gave it and, just below, only the last four characters of the key, so you can tell which one it is. In the corner, a badge says whether the key is working; the next lesson explains each badge. "Add credential" adds another key.
Só o final da chave: Only the end of the key
Modelos, uso e os botões do cartão: Models, usage and the card's buttons
\"Modelos\" conta quantos modelos de IA: "Models" counts how many AI models the provider made available to that key in the last check; if the key did not pass the check, a dash appears. "In use by" counts how many agent versions are linked to it, including drafts and old versions; the agent chooses the key in the "Access key" field of its editor. Below are three buttons: the pencil edits the key, the circular arrows test the key again and the trash icon deletes it.
O gerente vê esta tela só para consultar: Managers see this screen for reference only: "Add credential" and the card buttons do not appear for them. Adding, editing, testing again and deleting are tasks for the administrator.
Saber se uma chave está funcionando e o: Know whether a key is working and what to do when it is rejected or has not been checked yet.
Toda chave cadastrada passa por uma conf: Every key you add goes through a check: the system asks the provider whether it is valid. "Validated", in green, means the provider accepted the key. The AI only uses validated keys.
\"Inválida\", em vermelho, quer dizer qu: "Invalid", in red, means the check failed. The red sentence below the name gives the reason. Here the provider rejected the key: for example, it was only partly copied or was deleted on the provider's website. When the problem is the key itself, the sentence includes the "Where to get the key" link, which opens the provider's page where you create a new key. Then replace the key with the pencil, as shown in the "Replace, rename or delete a key" lesson.
Nem sempre a culpa é da chave. Se o prov: The key is not always to blame. If the provider is down, or if this server cannot reach it, the sentence says so and asks you to test again later.
Não validada: a conferência não terminou: Not validated: the check did not finish
Logo depois de salva, a chave aparece co: Right after it is saved, the key shows as "Validating…" while the system checks with the provider, and the screen updates on its own. If the result does not arrive within two minutes, the badge changes to "Not validated": the check did not finish. Click the circular arrows, "Revalidate credential", to test the key again right away. The result appears on the badge.
Depois de trocar a chave de um cartão qu: After you replace the key on a card that already existed, the badge also shows "Not validated" for a few seconds while the new key is checked.
Escolher o provedor, colar a chave e gua: Choose the provider, paste the key and store it for the agents to use.
Antes, entre no site do provedor que voc: First, go to the website of the provider you signed up with, create a key and copy all of it. Then come back here and click "Add credential".
Em \"Provedor\", escolha a empresa de IA: Under "Provider", choose the AI company you signed up with. The form opens with Anthropic (Claude) already selected. Below the field, a short sentence says when it is worth choosing that provider.
A lista traz todos os provedores que o s: The list shows every provider the system knows how to use. The ones at the top can talk with the customer. The last one, "Jev (TypeSafe AI)", does not talk: it only makes quick decisions, such as noticing whether the customer is annoyed. Here we choose Anthropic (Claude).
\"Provedor personalizado (compatível com: "Custom provider (OpenAI-compatible)" is for those who have their own server that speaks like OpenAI: the form also asks for the "Address (base URL)" and tests the connection before saving. "OpenAI via subscription (ChatGPT)" does not accept a pasted key: the account connects through its own login panel, which only appears on this screen when the server administrator enables "Codex subscription login" in Admin › Optional features.
Em \"Nome\", escreva um nome que ajude a: Under "Name", write a name that helps you recognize the key later. It is optional: if left blank, the key gets the provider's name. Under "Key", paste the key you copied; it appears as dots. If you do not have the key yet, "Where to get the key" opens the provider's page where it is created.
Duas chaves do mesmo provedor não podem: Two keys from the same provider cannot have the same name.
Clique em \"Salvar e validar\". A chave: Click "Save and validate". The key is stored encrypted and the form closes. Then the system checks the key with the provider, without you having to wait: the new card appears with "Validating…" and, within a few seconds, changes to "Validated" or "Invalid". "Cancel" closes the form without saving anything.
Trocar, renomear ou excluir uma chave: Replace, rename or delete a key
Trocar uma chave recusada sem desligar o: Replace a rejected key without disconnecting the agents, give a key another name and delete the one you no longer need.
chave nova no lugar da antiga: new key in place of the old one
A chave antiga da recepção foi recusada: The old reception key was rejected by the provider. To replace it, click the pencil, "Edit credential", on its card.
Cole a chave nova em \"Nova chave (opcio: Paste the new key into "New key (optional)" and click "Save". Replacing the key here keeps the agents linked to it: you do not need to change any agent. After saving, the system checks the new key with the provider, and the card's badge shows the result. When the badge shows "Validated", the agents already use the new key in the next conversation they handle.
Se uma chave vazou, crie outra no site d: If a key has leaked, create another one on the provider's website, replace it here and then delete the old one at the provider.
Para mudar só o nome, abra a edição pelo: To change only the name, open editing with the pencil, change the "Name" and leave "New key (optional)" blank. That way the key stays the same and nothing is checked again. Here the "Test key" gets a name that says what it is for. The "Save" button only becomes available when something has changed.
O nome novo na lista: The new name in the list
O cartão já aparece com o nome novo. Os: The card already shows the new name. The last four characters and the badge stay the same, because the key did not change.
A lixeira, \"Excluir credencial\", apaga: The trash icon, "Delete credential", deletes the key from the system. First, a window asks for confirmation: "Remove" deletes it permanently, and "Cancel" backs out. It cannot be undone.
Uma chave ligada a alguma versão de agen: A key linked to any agent version cannot be deleted: with "In use by" above zero, the trash icon is disabled, and hovering over it shows why. To replace that key, use the pencil. The Jev key is not locked: if Jev is turned on and using that key, the confirmation window explains what changes.
O cadastro das empresas com quem a sua e: The records of the companies your business works with: legal name, CNPJ, address and the people who make the decisions there.
Conhecendo a tela de Empresas: Getting to know the Companies screen
Encontrar a tela de Empresas, entender o: Find the Companies screen, understand what each column in the list shows and locate a company with search.
Empresas mora em Ver tudo em CRM: Companies lives in View everything in CRM
Empresas é o cadastro das empresas com q: Companies holds the records of the companies you do business with: the name, the CNPJ, the address and the people who make the decisions there. At Clínica Bem Viver, these are the companies that hire health programs for their employees. To get there, open "View everything in CRM", in the "CRM" group of the side menu, and click the "Companies" card, in the "Everyday sales work" section. The path is CRM › View everything in CRM › Companies.
O cartão só aparece quando quem administ: The card only appears when the server administrator turns on "Companies and people (B2B sales)" in Admin › Optional features. When it is off, the screen disappears for everyone. When it is on, any role can open the list, including "Read-only".
A tela mostra uma linha por empresa, e a: The screen shows one row per company, with the most recently changed ones at the top. The columns are "Trade name" (the name the company is known by), "Legal name" (the official, registered name), "CNPJ", "City/State", "Status" and "Updated" (when the record last changed). A dash "—" means that information has not been filled in yet. Click the trade name to open the company profile.
A lista mostra as 50 empresas que mudara: The list shows the 50 most recently changed companies. If the company you are looking for does not appear, use search.
A \"Situação\" vem do cadastro da Receit: "Status" comes from the records of Brazil's Federal Revenue Service: "ATIVA" means the CNPJ is active there. This information is brought in by BrasilAPI, a free online service that looks up the public data of a CNPJ. Until the lookup has brought the status, the column shows the lookup's progress, in English: "pending" means there has been no lookup yet, as with the company registered without a CNPJ, and "failed" means the lookup failed. During a lookup, "processing" may appear.
Uma consulta que falhou pode ser repetid: A failed lookup can be repeated with the "Enrich CNPJ" button, on the company profile. You will see this in the lesson about the profile.
No campo \"Buscar por nome ou CNPJ\", di: In the "Search by name or CNPJ" field, type part of the trade name, the legal name or the CNPJ. The CNPJ can go with its punctuation, as it appears in the list, or with numbers only. The list filters itself as you type, without having to press Enter. Here, "Ribeiro" found the accounting firm. To see all of them again, delete what you typed.
Quando a busca não acha nada, a lista mo: When the search finds nothing, the list shows "No companies yet.". That does not mean the records are empty: only that no company matches what you typed.
Criar o cadastro de uma empresa pela tel: Create a company record from the screen, understand the "Look up CNPJ" button and check the new company in the list.
Para cadastrar uma empresa, clique em \": To register a company, click "New company", at the top right of the list.
Só quem tem o papel \"Gerente\" ou \"Adm: Only people with the "Manager" or "Administrator" role can create. The button appears for the whole team, but for other roles the record is rejected when they click "Create".
Abre a janela \"Nova empresa\". Para cri: The "New company" window opens. To create, you only need to fill in one of these three fields: "Legal name", "Trade name" or "CNPJ". While all three are empty, the "Create" button stays disabled. Email, phone and address are optional.
Apagado até preencher um: Disabled until one is filled in
Consultar CNPJ preenche para você: Look up CNPJ fills it in for you
Se você tem o CNPJ, digite-o no campo \": If you have the CNPJ, type it in the "CNPJ" field: the "Look up CNPJ" button, disabled while the field is empty, becomes active. When you click it, the number goes to BrasilAPI, which returns the company's public data, and the window fills in the legal name, trade name, address, email and phone. Nothing is saved at this point: check the fields and only then click "Create". If the lookup does not work, the reason appears in red and you can fill in the fields by hand.
Se a consulta der certo e esse CNPJ já e: If the lookup works and that CNPJ is already in your company list, a notice appears, and "Create" is rejected if you insist. When you create a company with a CNPJ, the system looks it up on BrasilAPI by itself right afterwards and, if that works, saves the public data over what was typed, including name, address, email and phone. Looking up a CNPJ is only for managers or administrators, just like registering.
Sem o CNPJ em mãos, deixe o campo \"CNPJ: Without the CNPJ at hand, leave the "CNPJ" field empty: you can create with just the name and complete it later. Here the clinic registers a gym that wants to hire the health program for its instructors: "Trade name", "Email", "Phone", "City" and "State". Click "Create".
A empresa nova na lista: The new company in the list
A janela fecha e a academia aparece no a: The window closes and the gym appears at the top of the list, because it was the last to change. "Legal name" and "CNPJ" show a dash, and "Status" shows "pending": without a CNPJ, there is nothing to look up. When you have the number, open the company profile, use "Edit company" to add it and then "Enrich CNPJ" to fetch the public data.
